description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Turkish Tactician Style, Turkish Teamwork or Turkish Knack, 11 ranks in Sense Motive and a Base Attack Bonus +7

Benefit: When in Turkish Tactician Style and benefiting from Assessment, you can grant an ally an attack of opportunity, cast a spell without provoking an attack of opportunity, or sacrifice your flanking bonus for a combat maneuver check that grants your ally a follow-up attack.

system.requirements: Turkish Tactician Style, Turkish Teamwork or Turkish Knack, 11 ranks in Sense Motive and a Base Attack Bonus +7
